rationale: Edge-case lens ran cleanly and its 3 candidates were all confirmed live in current source: a whitespace-only display_name duplicates the project code in the new two-line name cell, an explicit backend routing:null can never clear a previously merged routing label, and a $0 classifier cost is hidden rather than shown. All three are kept as blocking patches; nothing was deferred or dismissed. Blind and verification-gap are out of scope for the compact profile (not failures); acceptance found no spec/story artifact (genuine no-spec), which caps confidence at low. Standards was not expected for this profile, so its rows are na with no coverage gap.

findings.title: Classifier cost row hidden at $0
findings.problem: The new 'Classifier cost' row is added only `if (classifierCost)`, a truthiness check, so a `total_classifier_cost_usd` of exactly 0 skips the row entirely — identical to the field being absent.
findings.impact: An admin reading the usage-details overlay cannot tell 'classifier ran and cost nothing' apart from 'classifier did not run', undermining the diagnostic value the new row was added for.
findings.recommendation: Check `classifierCost !== undefined && classifierCost !== null` instead of truthiness so a $0.0000 result still renders.

findings.title: Whitespace display_name duplicates project code
findings.problem: `getProjectDisplayName` falls back to `item.name` when `display_name` trims to empty, but the secondary code line's guard (`item.display_name && ...`) only checks truthiness, not trim. A whitespace-only `display_name` is truthy, so both the primary label and the secondary line render `item.name`. The backend's `display_name` field carries no trim/whitespace validation, so a pre-existing or directly-API-set whitespace value reaches this cell unguarded.
findings.impact: The project row in the very two-line cost-center-style list this change introduces shows the same project code twice, implying a distinct display name that does not exist — undermining the readability improvement this task set out to deliver.
findings.recommendation: Guard the secondary line with the same trim check used by `getProjectDisplayName`, e.g. `item.display_name?.trim() && <span>...`.

findings.title: Routing label can never be cleared once set
findings.problem: `existingThought.routing = thought.routing ?? existingThought.routing` treats an explicit `routing: null` from the backend the same as an absent field, because `??` falls through on `null`, not just `undefined`.
findings.impact: If the backend streams `routing: null` on a later update to intentionally clear a prior routing decision, the stale routed-model label from an earlier merge is kept and keeps displaying indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Use `'routing' in thought ? thought.routing : existingThought.routing` so an explicit null is honored, mirroring the presence-check idiom this file already uses for other mergeable fields.
